title: Peacock wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- tail fan feathers -->
  <g>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='44' ry='16' fill='#1f7a5c'/>
    <ellipse cx='24' cy='70' rx='12' ry='18' fill='#2fae7e' transform='rotate(-40 24 70)'/>
    <ellipse cx='76' cy='70' rx='12' ry='18' fill='#2fae7e' transform='rotate(40 76 70)'/>
    <ellipse cx='12' cy='80' rx='10' ry='14' fill='#2fae7e' transform='rotate(-60 12 80)'/>
    <ellipse cx='88' cy='80' rx='10' ry='14' fill='#2fae7e' transform='rotate(60 88 80)'/>
    <!-- eyespots -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='88' r='9' fill='#0d5c8a'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='88' r='6' fill='#ffcc33'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='88' r='3' fill='#0d3b5c'/>
    <circle cx='30' cy='78' r='7' fill='#0d5c8a'/>
    <circle cx='30' cy='78' r='4.5' fill='#ffcc33'/>
    <circle cx='30' cy='78' r='2' fill='#0d3b5c'/>
    <circle cx='70' cy='78' r='7' fill='#0d5c8a'/>
    <circle cx='70' cy='78' r='4.5' fill='#ffcc33'/>
    <circle cx='70' cy='78' r='2' fill='#0d3b5c'/>
  </g>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='15' ry='20' fill='#1e6fb8'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='45' y='34' width='10' height='20' rx='5' fill='#38a3e0'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='28' r='13' fill='#38a3e0'/>
  <!-- crest feathers -->
  <line x1='50' y1='16' x2='48' y2='6' stroke='#38a3e0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='6' r='2.5' fill='#ffcc33'/>
  <line x1='44' y1='17' x2='40' y2='8' stroke='#38a3e0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='8' r='2.5' fill='#ffcc33'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='17' x2='60' y2='8' stroke='#38a3e0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='8' r='2.5' fill='#ffcc33'/>
  <!-- sunglasses -->
  <rect x='37' y='23' width='12' height='8' rx='3' fill='#101820'/>
  <rect x='51' y='23' width='12' height='8' rx='3' fill='#101820'/>
  <rect x='49' y='26' width='2' height='2' fill='#38a3e0'/>
  <!-- lens shine -->
  <line x1='39' y1='25' x2='43' y2='29' stroke='#7fd4ff' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='53' y1='25' x2='57' y2='29' stroke='#7fd4ff' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <path d='M50 33 L46 40 L50 39 L54 40 Z' fill='#ffb03a'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <line x1='46' y1='80' x2='44' y2='92' stroke='#ffb03a' stroke-width='3'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='80' x2='56' y2='92' stroke='#ffb03a' stroke-width='3'/>
  <path d='M40 93 L44 93 L48 93' stroke='#ffb03a' stroke-width='3' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M52 93 L56 93 L60 93' stroke='#ffb03a' stroke-width='3' fill='none'/>
</svg>
